facts.text: The resort covers 37,000 acres of wilderness, with over 100 miles of trails and 10 miles of the Blackfoot River.

facts.text: Paws Up is a working cattle ranch.

facts.text: Spa Town is a colony of tents joined by a wooden boardwalk that runs alongside a brook.

facts.text: Spa Town's private treatment tents have heated massage tables and open-air views of the meadow, often spotted with horses.

facts.text: A complimentary pet massage comes with any 60-minute spa service.
